description: Explicitly accept the deliverable on a delivered quote. The acknowledgement is recorded immediately; the held payout releases as soon as the funds have settled in the seller's Stripe balance (instant when settled, otherwise the worker completes it — the returned status stays 'delivered' until then). Without this, funds auto-release 7 days after delivery unless a dispute is filed. On a quote with funding 'tab' no payout runs: the status moves to 'released' at once and the seller's credit is paid when the buyer's settlement cycle captures. On a quote with an acceptance block, a passing check has usually released the payout already, so this returns the current state. Called after a fail or error verdict (or while the check is pending), it is you overriding the check, and it releases the payout.

service_quote_id.description: UUID of the delivered quote thread to accept.
